title: Pure Kaiju
summary: Kaiju cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Every Kaiju summons itself onto the opponent's field by tributing one of their monsters, which gets rid of almost anything. Once they have a Kaiju, you can summon your own next to it. Each player can control only one Kaiju. Kaiju Counters pay for their effects. Kyoutou Waterfront gains one each time a card leaves the field and searches a Kaiju once it has three. Gameciel negates an activation by spending two, Jizukiru negates a targeting effect and destroys a card, and Dogoran destroys all their monsters. Interrupted Kaiju Slumber wipes the field and puts a Kaiju on each side, and later banishes itself from the GY to search a Kaiju. The Kaiju Files swaps a Kaiju for a different one and searches a Kaiju Spell/Trap. Super Anti-Kaiju War Machine Mecha-Thunder-King, the newest card (2019), banishes a Kaiju you control that the opponent owns and revives a monster from your GY.
